object.description: Read an object file holding attr name='rationale' with text 'because'. Set an attribute already present, and one not yet set. Set an enumeration attribute to the empty value; remove an option used by an object. Expected: each value reads back as written; an attribute set to empty, or whose option was removed, reads as set with an empty value, not as not set.
